title: PanWatch packages market monitoring into a self-hosted AI assistant
friendlyTitle: PanWatch is a self-hosted AI market monitor
summary: PanWatch is a self-hosted market-monitoring project for Chinese, Hong Kong and US equities, combining portfolio tracking, alerts and multi-agent analysis. The MIT-licensed repository has about 1,500 stars and recent development activity.
friendlySummary: PanWatch combines stock tracking, alerts, portfolio tools and AI analysis in software you can run yourself. It covers several major markets.
whyItMatters: Technically inclined users can inspect or run a private dashboard that combines market data, scheduled reports and configurable AI analysis. It should be treated as an information tool, not as verified financial advice or an autonomous trading authority.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to explore market-monitoring workflows while keeping the system under your control. Do not treat its AI output as guaranteed financial advice.
